summary: Nutrien Ltd. filed a 6-K cautioning shareholders regarding an unsolicited mini-tender offer by Ocehan LLC to purchase up to 100,000 common shares (0.02% of outstanding) at C$70.20/share, a 24.91% discount to the TSX closing price and 26.13% discount to NYSE closing price on May 8, 2026. Nutrien does not endorse the offer and notes it lacks standard investor protections. Although this is a tender offer, it is de minimis, unsolicited, and at a deep discount, making it a cautionary filing rather than a substantive special situation. Watch for SEC/CSA advisories on mini-tenders.
